gaps.sentence: The project is ___ way to completion ahead of schedule.
Given the budget, a new stadium is ___ of the question.
gaps.explanation: 'Out of the question' = not even worth considering.'

gaps.sentence: ___ any rate, we still have enough time.
gaps.explanation: 'At any rate' = whatever else is true.

gaps.sentence: We spoke ___ the phone for an hour.
___ terms of quality, the cheaper model wins.
The scheme paid off in the ___ — we recouped every euro.
The library stays open ___ to midnight during the exam period.
gaps.explanation: 'Up to midnight' = until as late as midnight.

gaps.sentence: I did it ___ my own initiative — nobody asked me.
gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.
